correctness.rationale: Over \(\mathbb F_2\), diagonalizable matrices are exactly idempotents. Rank-one factorization of every nonzero square-zero \(3\times3\) matrix plus the determinant lemma excludes precisely the proposed Jordan and irreducible-cubic types; explicit witnesses cover the other ten rational-canonical types. Exact enumeration of all 512 matrices independently returns the same 380/132 split and the four class sizes 42,42,24,24.
